xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-fin:NameOfTheCompany: Indian Railway Catering And Tourism Corporation Limited
xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-fin:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialR: 1 The results reviewed by AC & approved by BOD in its meeting held on 29.05.23. SA have conducted audit of Fin. Statements. 2 The audited Fin. Results prepared in accordance with Ind-AS, u/s 133 of Co. Act, 2013 read with Companies (IAS) Rules, 2015. 3 Fig. for the qtr ended 31.03.23 & 31.03.22 represents the derived fig. b/w audited fig. in respect of relevant FY & the unaudited published year upto 31st Dec being date of end of the Q3 of the relevant FY. 4 Rly. Bd. vide CC no. CC60 of 2019 inc. catering tariff for post & pre-paid trains. However, effect of LF from 18.11.2019 to 22.03.2020 (for post paid trains) & 27.11.2021 to 31.12.2022 (for post & pre-paid trains) on a/c of inc. in tariff, has not been ascertained & recognized. After resumption of regular trains services, co. started process of sales assessment during 22-23 & it has been completed. Further, co. raised demand notices for increased LF for pre-paid trains but some of licensees challenged in Hon’ble HC of Mumbai. As the matter is sub- judice, hence impact of increase in LF for pre-paid trains has not been recognized in fin. statement for FY 22-23. 5 Co. has recognised Rly Share of Rs. 546.60 Lakhs. @ 15% of profit of RN Segment for FY 22-23. During PY 21-22, Rs. 2713.32 lakhs was paid & charged to revenue as 15% Rly share in profits of RN plants up to 31.3.2021 as Rlys have not agreed with co. No provision was made for FY 21-22 in view of loss incurred in RN segment after considering payment of Rs. 2713.32 lakhs as expense for that year. Matters/amounts are subject to confirmation and reconciliation with Rlys. 6 As per tender, in respect of 4 PPP RN plants, DCOs are to be reimbursed GST on sales net of ITC availed by them. The impact for the same of Rs. 442.46 lakhs has been accounted for in FY22-23 except for the2 plants. In PY 21-22 impact of Rs.309.28 lakhs was accounted except for 01 plant. Due to non-availability of ITC claimed by respective DCOs of 2 plants for the entire FY 22-23 and 01 plant for March’23, the same could not be estimated & accounted in the respective qtrs. & these DCOs have represented against the claim for ITC. Co. intends to take opinion from Ex-ASG and necessary decision will be taken accordingly. 7 NAA issued notice for profiteering amt. of Rs.5041.44 Lakhs u/s 171 of CGST Act, 2017 for not passing the benefit of tax reduction to consumers. SCN has been contested & matter was argued in Aug.,22 but final order still awaited. However, CCI which has been vested with powers to adjudicate all such cases. Now proceedings, if any, will be commenced afresh by CCI & as on date no communication has been received from CCI in this matter. 8 Arbitration award was pronounced in April, of Rs.7400 Lakhs plus simple int. @6% pa from July, 18 onwards, in favour of certain licensees. Matter has been referred to Rlys as main liability would be of Rlys & the Co. has right to recovery from Rlys. The Co. has filed objections against Arbitration award and it listed before HC of Delhi on 28.09.2022. Next date of hearing is 19.7.2023. 9 For FY 23, net Y on a/c of Exceptional items of Rs.2720.00 Lakhs incls excess provisions written back for PY for PRP, Rs.1085.74 lakhs as excess provisions written back for PY relating to IT & Rs.435.67 Lakhs being excess provisions written back for PY for other expenses. 10 In Dec. 2022, GOI further disinvested 400 Lakhs no. of shares of the Company through OFS. 11 The BOD has proposed final dividend of Rs. 2 per share subject to approval of the shareholders at the ensuing AGM. This is in addition to the interim dividend of Rs. 3.50 per share, thereby making total dividend for FY 2022-23 to Rs. 5.50 per share. 12 The fig. for the previous year/periods have been regrouped/reclassified/restated, wherever considered necessary.
